name: brand-aronia
title: Aronia brand theme
description: The aronia theme (아로니아): a blue action fill dark enough that white labels clear 5:1, a cool grey paper, 1px hairlines, a radius ladder anchored at 8 with each control's corner following its size, Pretendard for display and body text on a type ladder anchored at 16, and a high-contrast variant. Select it with `data-brand="aronia"` on <html>; with no such attribute the default brand from `styles` renders. Install both — import order does not matter, the cascade is decided by selector specificity.
